# Ball: a faceted white ball r 0.16 m with a pink band round its equator (so its roll reads).
# Origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Ball --base-color 0.9804 1.0000 0.9882 --no-slot
material new Band --base-color 1.0000 0.4235 0.4784 --no-slot
add mesh ico-sphere --name Ball --subdivisions 2 --radius 0.16 --location 0 0 0
material assign Ball
mode edit
select face where "abs(pos.x) < 0.045"
material assign Band
mode object
shade flat
export ball.glb
